scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail -n backend,frontend -c blue,green "pnpm --filter backend dev" "wait-on http://localhost:3000/api/pocs && pnpm --filter frontend dev --host"

scripts.test: pnpm --filter backend test && pnpm --filter frontend test
